title: Keto Treacle Temptation
description: A nutty, silky Canadian dish featuring treacle in a keto-friendly recipe perfect for weeknight dinners.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine cocoa powder and coconut oil until well blended.
Gradually add maple syrup while continuously stirring. Mix in vanilla extract until fully combined.
Stir in baking soda then fold in chopped walnuts carefully to prevent overmixing.
Transfer mixture into an 8x8 inch baking dish lined with parchment paper.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Drizzle treacle (if using) on top of the warm treat before serving.
